name: Mugello Circuit
description: Ferrari's own circuit in the Tuscan hills. Climbs and drops all lap, with fast, flowing corners like the two Arrabbiatas, and a long straight that falls away into San Donato.
direction_note: Points are ordered in race direction. Index 0 is the start/finish line.
raceline_source: modules/tracks/tools/raceline.py (minimum lap time, GT3 point-mass model)

elevation.source: Terrarium elevation tiles, AWS Open Data (SRTM, USGS 3DEP, national lidar), smoothed

barriers.source: OpenStreetMap barriers (0 of 2098 edge points mapped) and gravel areas, defaults by corner and circuit style elsewhere
